opencv.js 4.9.0 — official build from https://docs.opencv.org/4.9.0/opencv.js
(the newest version the docs site still serves as a single file).
Self-hosted on purpose rather than installed from npm: it's ~10 MB, only the
camera-capture worker (public/workers/scan-worker.js) loads it, and keeping
it out of the Angular build avoids another build-tool-sensitive dependency.
